name: Candidate outreach drafting
summary: For each person a recruiter or founder has already chosen to approach about an approved role: a first message and two follow-ups, each personal line traced to a public work source the recruiter supplied, do-not-contact names and opt-outs honoured, and a reply log. The recruiter sends every message.

sources.title: The rule that every personal line traces to a public work source the recruiter supplied, within a freshness limit; the list of characteristics never mentioned or inferred; the do-not-contact check with possible matches; pay and terms only as the brief allows; the reply log's events, statuses and next actions; the dating rules and word limits; the output format, stop conditions, tests and the worked example.

sources.contribution: Opening on one detail from the person's public work; short, truthful messages with a small ask; a few messages spaced in working days, each adding something new; a message naming the referrer; returning months later when the timing was wrong; and the opt-out line, keeping to unsubscribes and the do-not-contact list, no return after a no, and personal matters kept out.
Its outreach and engagement workflow: personalize the first message from public signals such as talks, code and posts, with no inference about the person, and stop the follow-ups on an opt-out.

Its ethics notes: avoid search filters that stand in for age, gender or ethnicity, honour prior contact and the do-not-contact list, and stop outreach at once on an unsubscribe or an explicit decline.
Following each person from first contact through a reply to a later revisit or a close, the root of the reply log's statuses.
